summary: Silvio Berlusconi was convicted of having sex with an underage prostitute, sentenced to seven years and banned from public office. Prosecutors said she was Moroccan-born dancer Karima El Mahroug, aka Ruby Rubacuori, who denies sex but admits receiving thousands of euros. The court found he abused his office by pressuring Milan police to release her, and he is appealing a separate tax‑fraud conviction.
